title: [codex] Physically lower delayed-cover batch split and return
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This physically implements the delayed-cover low-type split/return boundary that #5829 supplies as a reference address map. For each fixed `L >= 2`, two finite programs on **L+7 physical tapes** split an arbitrary stream `(a,l,r)` into its L complete banks and merge arbitrary changed child outputs into their original addresses. Positive runtime A,R are binary tape inputs. With `V=A*L*R`, the written unbounded proof gives **time <=94V and visited space <=13V**, including binary setup, head returns, scratch markers and erased backing. Entry backing remains charged separately.

The running tables use only symbol branches, writes, unit moves and fixed jumps. They do not read host coordinates, counters, payload lists or a runtime tape index. For the actual #5829 map, `A=T*(LH)^(D-j-1)` and `R=H^(j+1)*R_body`; every current/ancestor high matrix remains inside the complete child batch. The child volume is V/L, preserving the predecessor's geometry rather than dropping a cover factor.

A separate physical composition executes these literal tables through the retained 3-bit codec, actual segment push, output relay **before destructive pop**, and replacement of an occupied parent bank. For each fixed L its compiled inventory is K+7 tapes, K=max(16,L+8); the small cases use23 and the L9 control uses24. It executes two sequential siblings and genuine unequal child volumes, with the actual high-field shape update `A_parent=L*H*A_child`, `R_child=H*R_parent`. The exact source address identity preserves both parent and child high fields; volume equality alone is insufficient. Its grammar has at most one child edge, physical child-shape grants and an explicitly named bit-complement leaf. It is not the full production traversal or a Gaussian child.

This closes one concrete physical interface. There is no paid-profile or kappa change, selected-frontier edit, full assumption discharge or scientific-admission claim.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; revision8, `uniform-transfer-audit`, scope **changed** under the continuing donor task. The abstract batch mapping/ancestor-weight condition/volume divisor already belong to [#5829](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5829); the physical machine and counter framework come unchanged from [#2776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2776). The generic segmented allocator and existing codec/output-return routines are reused with original notices. The added value is a source-bound literal physical router and its actual smaller-child return boundary, rather than another abstract cover map or count.

Sixteen generic pins resolve to the canonical base; one binds the unchanged router to the reachable first submission9ff1c912. Source copies are authenticated before import. The existing all-column census and generic allocation theorems are not claimed as new. A bounded live/source overlap audit found no matching complete physical boundary; this is not a world-priority claim.

## Validation

Python3.12, standard library only. Six registered checks passed: main, separate interpreter and physical composition, each normal and optimized. The main checks110 arbitrary-data/descriptor fixtures and the actual retained5829 address functions. A separately written interpreter checks198 split/merge cases and256 converter cases without executing the source Machine/Tape implementation. The physical composition checks33 cases, all16 four-bit inputs, real H2/H3 updates, a24-tape L9 control and1303487 measured read/write/unit-move actions, parent-byte/head preservation, sibling reuse and scratch/relay retirement. Semantic controls reject lost input, invalid descriptors, early pop, occupied-output alias, omitted child work and confusing logical with physical blanks.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/delayed-cover-physical-batch-routing
```

The final high-H/K head `a7a22201327689fc81496cf031d68e53283fef49` passed a53-file Git-free six-check replay in2.913s. All53 input files remained byte-identical. A separate author-side address audit checked216 domains /880380 addresses in normal and optimized modes; the exact committed code and17 source pins passed the publication audit.

Finite checks corroborate the written all-size induction and exact ledgers. All reviews/implementations are author-side AI-assisted evidence. No historical native, full selected supplier, Lean or Docker suite was rerun.

## Credit and open next questions

Ali Romman supplies whole-high batch geometry and retained allocator lineage; David Arias supplies the unchanged literal machine, assembler and binary counter; Mason Hale and the retained segment/codec/output-return authors supply physical suspension and return. Original source notices remain exact. New physical lowering and separate review: thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex/parallel-agent assistance, Apache-2.0.

TASK.json identifies the next source-bound steps: generate the real binary shape/ancestor-weight descriptors at these ports, then complete the route/fallback, Gaussian-child, precision and production-dispatcher applications. Their costs are not zero and all five project assumptions remain retained. The intended review lane is scoped validated research; scientific acceptance remains pending.
